content:
iPadOS 27.2 will be released at the end of this month, bringing a new round of system updates to the iPad. The following are two of the new features.

#1: Siri Context Pop-up Window

The Siri AI is a significant upgrade over the older version of Siri. I use it on my iPad all the time — often with the CMD + Space keyboard shortcut, because Siri and Spotlight have now been merged into one.

In iPadOS 27.2, Apple has added another convenient way to interact with Siri. This feature first appeared on Mac with macOS Golden Gate.

When you select text on iPadOS 27.2 using a trackpad or mouse, a new Siri context window will pop up on the left side of your selection. If you move your cursor over the Siri icon, it will instantly expand, giving you a text field to 'Ask Siri'.

This makes it quick and convenient to ask Siri any question about the content you have selected. If you are writing something, the Siri pop-up will also offer suggestions such as 'Proofread', 'Rewrite' and 'Read Aloud' — just one tap away to be helpful.

#2: Apple TV App Adds Profiles Feature

Whether you are an adult or a child, the iPad is a great device for watching videos. If you share an iPad with your partner or kids, the Apple TV app is about to add a popular new feature: user profiles.

iPadOS 27.2 will introduce the same profiles feature that tvOS already provides on the Apple TV 4K.

When you open the Apple TV app on your iPad, you will see a new profile selection screen at launch. Once you choose who is using the device, the TV app will automatically update its Up Next list, viewing history and content recommendations based on your selection.

If you are a parent, the profiles feature will take content restrictions into account. When your child's profile is active, they will only see movies and shows that match the age restrictions you have previously set.

For more new features in iPadOS 27.2, please refer to our related coverage.
